Name: Alvar Cloak
Notes: Made in Alvar, cloaks of this quality are often seen on the shoulders of the more wealthy members of the Alvarian Merchant Guild.

Name: Necromancer Cloak
Notes: Clearly a cloak made for a practitioner of the dark arts. This fine cloak is worked with arcane designs embroidered in darkened silver thread.

Name: Traveller's Hat
Notes: A simple hat meant to keep sun and dust off a traveller's head.

Name: Fancy Hat
Notes: The latest in fashion, this hat harkens back to more of a working class style.  It isn't really the hat that's in style, it's the working man that young nobles are trying to emulate--who in turn seeks to emulate the nobleman…

Name: Shadow's Mask
Notes: A mask designed to hide the identity of the wearer, it has also been magically enhanced to offer good protection and to aid thiefly pursuits.

Name: Moon Cloak
Notes: This cloak signifies the highest rank attainable by a Priest of the Moon.  No more than nine of these cloaks were ever made--one for each member of the High Council of the Moon.

Name: Cloth Hat
Notes: A common hat.  The material is a blend of cotton and wool, and the feather is from a duck.

Name: Wizard Cap
Notes: Don't laugh--while silly--even ridiculous--in appearance, many sorcerers spend quite a bit of time enchanting hats like this with powerful magics.  The conical shape and 'eyes' in the front of the hat are peculiarly attractive to creatures of the spirit world, and that property makes the hat easier to enchant.

Name: Wreath Crown
Notes: This is a poorly wrought crown, the kind that goblins or low budget actors might create to mock royalty.  It offers no real head protection, although it may carry some small enchantment.

Name: Old Leather Boots
Notes: Common traveler's boots made with leather and hobnailed. Their previous owner didn't maintain them very well, and the leather appears discolored and warped in places.

Name: Ultimate Boots
Notes: Dragonhide boots reinforced with molded horn strips and stalt metal rivets.  Soft and light, they provide unparalleled foot protection.

Name: Lucius
Notes: No one knows where or when these magical boots were made, but many tales refer to them turning up in the most unusual places.  They grant their wearer superhuman quickness and grace of motion.  (Special Powers:  +30 Speed)

Name: Hermes
Notes: A relic from before the Silence, these boots must conceal some hidden magic as they are very heavy, yet light once worn.  They act upon the nerves and muscles of their wearer, heightening his speed and reflexes to inhuman levels, but simultaneously causing inaccuracy and over-compensation.  The boots have been owned by many through the ages, all of whom have died from some speed related accident, like running up a hill at blazing speeds and then falling down the cliff at the top.  (Special Powers:  +100 Speed and -40 Accuracy)
